# IMPL-LGGR-FINITE-RESULTS-LEAN

The source Lean gate is a finite Boolean holonomy model; it is not automatically identical to the external Rust allocation/gate implementation. Every section of each declared small cycle is enumerated, retaining the zero-mass exception. A six-vertex mixture on the odd triangle attains edge satisfaction2/3 with an explicit nonnegative dual slack table. The original Lean section-or-zero equivalence is freshly imported/rechecked on its literal signature.

Supported: Actual bounded cycle sections, gate fields, triangle primal mixture and matching2/3 dual controls are exact; the conditional source-model gate equivalence and attainment arithmetic are kernel checked.

Remaining: Prove the external Rust gate/representation and arbitrary LP/cycle refinements. Proposition II-open and physical-selection claims remain open; a census/route partition is not this proof.
